name: Student Budget
description: Under €300 — get started with local LLMs on a tight budget. Runs small but capable models for everyday chat and coding help.
setup_notes: RTX 4060 has 8GB VRAM — stick to models under 7B parameters or use Q4 quantization.
Mistral 7B at Q4 needs ~4.2 GB, leaving headroom for the OS and browser.
Install Ollama: https://ollama.com/download
Run your first model: ollama run phi4-mini

name: Developer Starter
description: €300–600 — 16GB VRAM unlocks 14B models in Q8 and serious coding assistants. The sweet spot for developers.
setup_notes: RX 9070 has 16GB GDDR6 — strong ROCm 6 support on Linux, limited on Windows.
Phi-4 14B at Q6 (12.6 GB) fits with headroom — excellent coding and reasoning quality.
On Windows, CUDA GPUs (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti 16GB) may have smoother Ollama experience.
Install Ollama: https://ollama.com/download
AMD ROCm setup: https://rocm.docs.amd.com/en/latest/deploy/linux/quick_start.html

name: Power User
description: €600–1200 — 24GB VRAM from used/value hardware. Runs Mistral 7B at FP16 or Phi-4 14B at Q8 with full quality.
setup_notes: RX 7900 XTX delivers 24GB VRAM for €900 — far better value than RTX 4090 for LLM use.
ROCm 6 on Linux is mature — Ollama 0.3+ supports this GPU natively.
For a CUDA alternative at similar price, the RTX 3090 (used) gives the same 24GB.
Install Ollama: https://ollama.com/download
Check GPU temps with: rocm-smi (AMD) or nvidia-smi (NVIDIA)

name: Multi-GPU Lab
description: Over €2000 — workstation-class 48GB+ VRAM for running 70B models at full quality, multi-model serving, or fine-tuning.
setup_notes: RTX 6000 Ada has 48GB ECC VRAM — runs Llama 70B at Q8 (~84 GB needed for full FP16, Q8 fits in 48GB).
For a budget multi-GPU alternative: 2× RTX 3090 (48GB NVLink) at ~€1200 total.
Use llama.cpp server for multi-GPU: --n-gpu-layers 99
Consider Unsloth or PEFT for fine-tuning on this hardware.
Install Ollama: https://ollama.com/download

name: Mac Setup
description: Apple Silicon with 128GB unified memory — silent, power-efficient, and capable of running 70B models at high quality.
setup_notes: M4 Max with 128GB unified memory — GPU and CPU share the same pool, so all 128GB is usable.
Llama 3.3 70B at Q4 needs ~42 GB; Q8 needs ~84 GB — both fit comfortably.
Metal backend is automatic with Ollama — no CUDA or ROCm drivers needed.
Install Ollama: https://ollama.com/download (macOS native build available)
Monitor memory: Activity Monitor → Memory tab, or: sudo powermetrics --samplers gpu_power

name: Used Market Deal
description: Best price-to-performance with used hardware. The dual RTX 3090 NVLink setup gives 48GB VRAM for ~€1200 — unmatched value.
setup_notes: Two RTX 3090s connected via NVLink give 48GB of shared VRAM — same as a €7000 RTX 6000 Ada.
Buy used from eBay/Kleinanzeigen: check GPU temps under load before buying.
NVLink bridge required: NVIDIA NVLink Bridge for RTX 30 series (~€50 used).
Use llama.cpp with tensor parallelism: ./llama-server --n-gpu-layers 99 -ts 1,1
Ollama multi-GPU support: set OLLAMA_NUM_GPU=2 in environment variables.
RTX 3090 single GPU (€600 used, 24GB) is also excellent if NVLink setup is too complex.
